documentary_inconsistencies: Article alternates between three and four modalities, although the executable conceptual scope is CODE/PROCESS/TEXT.
Article/thesis describe early fusion, learned meta-fusion/stacking and Platt; frozen evidence is fixed CODE+TEXT fusion and isotonic.
Manuscript asserts consistent multimodal improvement and completed XAI beyond repository evidence.
Project plan assumes approximately 9.54% positives and threshold targets; sealed TEST prevalence is 3.8844% and no threshold is frozen.

recommended_minimal_q1_rqs.text: Does multimodal integration improve temporally valid JIT prediction relative to unimodal baselines?
What incremental information is contributed by CODE, PROCESS, and TEXT?
Does the selected fusion strategy improve on simpler modality combinations?
Does post-hoc calibration improve reliability without unacceptable discrimination loss?
Are effects stable across temporal partitions and compatible external projects?
For accepted models, what predictive factors drive outputs and how stable/useful are explanations?
Does the model improve prioritization under realistic inspection budgets?

adoption_rule: Proposed alignment only; thesis/article must explicitly approve scope changes rather than silently replacing existing commitments.
